name: Nakama
hint: Game backend with accounts, realtime multiplayer, matchmaking, leaderboards and chat

CONSOLE_USERNAME.title: Console username
CONSOLE_USERNAME.description: The app's address opens the Nakama console: sign in with this username and the console password. Game clients use the same address on port 443 with SSL on.

SERVER_KEY.title: Server key
SERVER_KEY.description: Game clients send it when they authenticate, so set it in your client SDK in place of Nakama's defaultkey.

HTTP_KEY.title: Runtime HTTP key
HTTP_KEY.description: Lets your own servers call RPC functions at /v2/rpc/<id>?http_key=<this key> without a player session.

JS_ENTRYPOINT.title: JavaScript entrypoint
JS_ENTRYPOINT.description: Upload Lua (.lua) and Go (.so) modules to the modules volume with the Files tool and redeploy to load them. For a TypeScript or JavaScript runtime, upload its bundled file there and enter its name (index.js) here.

SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.title: Session encryption key
SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Signs players' session tokens. Changing it signs every player out.

REFRESH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.title: Refresh token encryption key
REFRESH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Signs players' refresh tokens, and must differ from the session encryption key.

CONSOLE_SIGNING_KEY.title: Console signing key
CONSOLE_SIGNING_KEY.description: Signs console sessions. Changing it signs everyone out of the console.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.title: Database password
POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Postgres sets it only when its volume is first created, so a later change also needs ALTER USER postgres PASSWORD in the database.
